flags.title: MiDAS Automated Fraud System — Mass False Fraud Flags
flags.summary: Michigan's MiDAS system generated over 40,000 false fraud determinations. Any UI fraud flag must be cross-checked against MiDAS error patterns.

flags.title: 20-Week UI Duration Cap — Shortest in Region
flags.summary: Michigan caps UI at 20 weeks, the shortest in the Great Lakes region. Federal extensions may apply during high unemployment.

flags.title: Healthy Michigan Plan Work Requirements (Enjoined)
flags.summary: Work requirements were approved but enjoined by federal courts. Monitor for reinstatement.

flags.title: Detroit Mass Water Shutoffs — UN Human Rights Concern
flags.summary: Detroit has conducted mass water shutoffs affecting tens of thousands. Shutoff assistance programs exist but are underfunded.

flags.title: Detroit Eviction Rate Among Highest in Nation
flags.summary: Detroit has one of the highest eviction rates in the US. Eviction diversion programs are active but capacity-limited.

flags.title: MI Minimum Wage Increase Track Through 2028
flags.summary: Michigan minimum wage is $10.56/hr with scheduled increases through 2028 under the Improved Workforce Opportunity Wage Act.

flags.title: 12 Federally Recognized Tribes — ICWA Applies
flags.summary: Michigan has 12 federally recognized tribes. ICWA applies for any child welfare matter involving enrolled members. Always check tribal enrollment before routing.

flags.title: Upper Peninsula Geographic Isolation
flags.summary: The UP is geographically remote with limited urban services. Phone and online access may be the only viable intake channels for many UP residents.

flags.title: Involuntary Hold: Michigan Emergency Admission
flags.message: MI involuntary psychiatric hold law: Michigan Emergency Admission. Statutory authority: MCL § 330.1427. Maximum initial hold duration: 24 hours. Legal standard: danger to self/others. A hearing must be held before the hold can be extended. The person has the right to counsel at the hearing.
action_items: Verify hold did not exceed 24 hours without court order
Confirm hearing was held within statutory timeframe
Check that patient rights notice was provided at admission
Request complete hold documentation from facility

flags.title: Psychiatric Patient Rights
flags.message: Psychiatric patients in MI retain fundamental rights during hospitalization: right to communicate with persons outside the facility, right to receive and send mail, right to access legal counsel, right to refuse treatment (with limited exceptions), right to informed consent, right to access medical records, and right to file grievances. These rights cannot be restricted as a condition of treatment.
action_items: Verify patient rights notice was provided and signed
Check whether any rights were restricted and if proper procedures were followed
Confirm access to legal counsel was not impeded

flags.title: Federal Restraint & Seclusion Limits
flags.message: Federal law (42 CFR § 482.13) sets strict limits on restraint and seclusion in MI: physician order required within 1 hour, face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour, continuous monitoring required, maximum 4 hours per order for adults (2 hours for ages 9-17, 1 hour for under 9), and restraint may only be used to protect the patient from harm — never as punishment, convenience, or retaliation.
action_items: Request restraint/seclusion logs for all episodes
Verify physician order was obtained within 1 hour
Check that face-to-face evaluation occurred within 1 hour
Verify restraint was not used as punishment or convenience
Check for injuries during restraint episodes
legal_references: CMS State Operations Manual Appendix A

flags.title: Involuntary Psychiatric Hold Statute
flags.message: This state has specific statutes governing involuntary psychiatric holds. Know the time limits, hearing rights, and appeal procedures before they expire.

flags.title: Mental Health Patient Bill of Rights
flags.message: This state has a Patient Bill of Rights for mental health facilities. Facilities must inform patients of these rights upon admission.
flags.statute: Michigan Mental Health Patient Rights Act

flags.title: Discharge Planning Requirements
flags.message: This state requires facilities to create discharge plans with follow-up appointments, medication management, and community resource referrals.
flags.statute: Michigan Mental Health Discharge Planning Standards
